prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlalchemy import update
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.core.errors import raise_not_found
+from app.models import Episode, Project, WorkspaceMember
+
+
+def lock_episode_project(
+    session: Session,
+    user_id: str,
+    *,
+    project_id: UUID | None = None,
+    episode_id: UUID | None = None,
+) -> Project:
+    project_key = project_id
+    if episode_id is not None:
+        project_key = select(Episode.project_id).where(Episode.id == episode_id).scalar_subquery()
+
+    conditions = (
+        Project.id == project_key,
+        Project.deleted_at.is_(None),
+        select(WorkspaceMember.user_id).where(
+            WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == Project.workspace_id,
+            WorkspaceMember.user_id == UUID(user_id),
+        ).exists(),
+    )
+    if session.get_bind().dialect.name == "sqlite":
+        # SQLite ignores FOR UPDATE. Acquire its write lock before reading the order.
+        session.execute(update(Project).where(*conditions).values(title=Project.title))
+    project = session.exec(select(Project).where(*conditions).with_for_update()).first()
+    if project is None:
+        raise_not_found("episode" if episode_id is not None else "project")
+    return project
+
+
+def ordered_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> list[Episode]:
+    return list(session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id, Episode.deleted_at.is_(None))
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+    ).all())
+
+
+def renumber_episodes(episodes: list[Episode]) -> None:
+    for order, episode in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if episode.episode_order != order:
+            episode.episode_order = order

+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def episode_project(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    response = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    return headers, response.json()["id"]
+
+
+def create_episode(client, headers, project_id, order):
+    response = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "title": f"Night Run {order}",
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": "A bus takes a detour.",
+        },
+    )
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    return response.json()["id"]
+
+
+def list_episode_order(client, headers, project_id):
+    response = client.get("/api/v1/episodes", params={"project_id": project_id}, headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    return [(episode["id"], episode["episode_order"]) for episode in response.json()]
+
+
+def test_restore_reinserts_episode_with_its_original_cuts(client, episode_project):
+    headers, project_id = episode_project
+    first, middle, last = (
+        create_episode(client, headers, project_id, order) for order in range(1, 4)
+    )
+    image = "data:image/png;base64,aW1hZ2U="
+    cut_response = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": middle,
+            "cut_order": 1,
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Last stop."}],
+            "image_path": image,
+        },
+    )
+    assert cut_response.status_code == 200, cut_response.text
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{middle}", headers=headers).status_code == 204
+    assert list_episode_order(client, headers, project_id) == [(first, 1), (last, 2)]
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/cuts", params={"episode_id": middle}, headers=headers).json() == []
+
+    endpoint = f"/api/v1/episodes/{middle}/restore"
+    response = client.post(endpoint, headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    restored = response.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == middle
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "A bus takes a detour."
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"] == image
+    expected = [(first, 1), (middle, 2), (last, 3)]
+    assert list_episode_order(client, headers, project_id) == expected
+    cuts = client.get("/api/v1/cuts", params={"episode_id": middle}, headers=headers)
+    assert cuts.status_code == 200, cuts.text
+    assert cuts.json() == [cut_response.json()]
+
+    assert client.post(endpoint, headers=headers).status_code == 404
+    assert list_episode_order(client, headers, project_id) == expected
+
+
+def test_restore_hides_deleted_episode_from_outsiders(client, episode_project):
+    owner, project_id = episode_project
+    outsider = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    episode_id = create_episode(client, owner, project_id, 1)
+    endpoint = f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/restore"
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}", headers=owner).status_code == 204
+
+    denied = client.post(endpoint, headers=outsider)
+    missing = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore", headers=owner)
+    assert denied.status_code == missing.status_code == 404
+    assert denied.json() == missing.json()
+    assert client.post(endpoint).status_code == 401
+    assert list_episode_order(client, owner, project_id) == []
+
+
+def test_restore_appends_if_previous_position_is_past_the_end(client, episode_project):
+    headers, project_id = episode_project
+    first, middle, last = (
+        create_episode(client, headers, project_id, order) for order in range(1, 4)
+    )
+    for episode_id in (last, middle):
+        assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}", headers=headers).status_code == 204
+
+    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{last}/restore", headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert list_episode_order(client, headers, project_id) == [(first, 1), (last, 2)]
